_comment_digest: sha256 over the episodes' canonical JSON, by episode id: one compact object per line (sort_keys, no spaces), so the digest does not depend on line endings or formatting.

catalog.products: data/products/fairprice-v2-snapshot.json (prices rounded to cents) and data/fixtures/fairprice-products.json for curated ingredients

candidate_pool.version: multidish-pool-v1 with the v3 per-course draw

labels.rule: every feasible label carries a witness week (whole packages) within its budget and all its bands; every infeasible one a slot with no valid meal
labels.proofs: the sealed packet's check.py in two views (the whole pool, and plannable recipes only) and the repository's python -m app.evaluation.multidish_labels; see verification.json

budgets.feasible_margin: budget / witness week between 1.15 and 1.40; the budget category between 1.15 and 1.25
budgets.infeasible_budgets: none: an impossible budget at a realistic amount cannot be proven with whole packages (owner, round 1)

nutrition: per-day bands only, over release per-serving nutrition
review_policy: drafted in a sealed packet, then reviewed by the owner in three rounds and revised on their written notes until accepted
